stem:
Uma models integers with tokens. She has $2$ positive tokens and must subtract $3$ positive tokens.

Which move lets her complete the subtraction?

options.text: Rename her $2$ positive tokens as negative tokens, and remove nothing.
Try to remove $3$ positive tokens at once, skipping any zero pairs, even though only $2$ positive tokens are present.
Add one zero pair (one positive and one negative token), then remove $3$ positive tokens; $1$ negative token remains.
Say the finished difference is what creates the need for zero pairs, instead of adding zero pairs before removal.

teacher.key_rationale: When the tokens to remove are not present, add zero pairs first so the value is unchanged, then remove the subtrahend tokens. Here one zero pair allows removal of 3 positives and leaves 1 negative.
